summary: Ran targeted backend + frontend regression checks for the GHG monthly unit P0 fix and UI styling/layout requests on the public preview URL. Backend calculate contracts passed, supplier Add GHG button styling is dark green, and responsibility field layout/label updates are correct. Mandatory end-to-end save payload verification for stale kg->L remains blocked because clicking Save in admin Create Emission flow produced no POST calls after 3 attempts.

ui_bugs.issue: After filling monthly row data and clicking Save emissions, no POST requests were dispatched to calc/save APIs across 3 attempts, blocking payload verification of qty unit propagation.

integration_issues.flow: Scope 1 -> Stationary -> Yearly to Monthly -> Save
integration_issues.issue: Could not capture /api/calc-engine/execute-by-category or /api/emissions requests from browser after Save click; therefore mandatory verification of saved qty unit=L vs stale kg is inconclusive.

action_items: Investigate why admin Create Emissions save click does not dispatch API requests in the tested Scope 1 monthly path (check client-side validation/toast gating and click handler path).
After Save dispatch works, re-run mandatory P0 verification and confirm emitted calc/save payload qty unit remains L after Yearly->Monthly toggle.
Recheck resolveMonthlySelectableUnit behavior for stale stored kg when both kg and L are allowed; current logic prioritizes storedUnit before configuredUnit.
critical_code_review_comments: resolveMonthlySelectableUnit currently sets candidate as storedUnit || configuredUnit; if storedUnit='kg' and allowedUnits include both kg and L, stale kg is retained instead of preferring configured L.
Step3YearMonthlyData initialization updates monthly unit only when stored unit is empty/disallowed; allowed-but-stale stored units are not normalized.
Step2ProcessResponsibility implementation matches requested desktop two-row order and consistent control height; label is 'Source of Information' (no 'Optional').
SupplierGHGSubmission empty-state Add GHG button class uses dark green (bg-emerald-800, hover:bg-emerald-900) as requested.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (layout + supplier styling passed; mandatory payload verification blocked)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Used admin and supplier credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md with preview URL from frontend/.env. Verified monthly qty selector can show L after Yearly->Monthly switch (unit-qty-04 showed L). Supplier account in this run had empty draft state and displayed dark-green Add GHG data button. No mocked APIs used.
rca of the issue: Observed blocker: Save emissions click did not emit calc/save network calls in browser during three repeated admin monthly attempts (with 1 filled month), so payload-level unit regression could not be proved/disproved via UI. Potential causes include client-side validation gate, early-return in submit orchestration, or non-firing click handler in current page state. MOCKED APIs: NONE.
